rows.source_note: User advisory-intelligence brief, 2026-09-21. Unverified shop starting point; confirm with a controlled sew-out.
rows.capture: Photograph the sew-out flat, in even light, filling most of the frame. This reduces perspective and shadow ambiguity.
rows.notes: Visible symptoms are not proof of a machine cause.

rows.source_note: User advisory-intelligence brief, 2026-09-21. Unverified shop starting point; confirm with a controlled sew-out.
rows.label: Lettering appears closed up
possible_causes: Pull compensation may be unsuitable for the fabric
rows.remedy: Inspect letter height, stitch density and pull compensation with a controlled sew-out.
rows.capability_gap: No per-letter satin generator or supported density/pull-compensation operation is registered. An exact adjustment is not established by this photo.

rows.source_note: User advisory-intelligence brief, 2026-09-21. Unverified shop starting point; confirm with a controlled sew-out.
rows.label: Possible puckering around stitching
possible_causes: Density may be unsuitable for the fabric
rows.remedy: Review backing and hooping; compare a controlled sample before changing density.
rows.capability_gap: Backing and hooping are physical actions; no supported density-adjustment operation is registered. A safe numeric adjustment is unknown.

rows.source_note: User advisory-intelligence brief, 2026-09-21. Unverified shop starting point; confirm with a controlled sew-out.
rows.label: Possible colour misregistration
rows.remedy: Check underlay, stabiliser and hooping on a controlled sample.
rows.capability_gap: No supported underlay-edit operation is registered; physical stabilisation cannot be applied in software.

rows.source_note: User advisory-intelligence brief, 2026-09-21. Unverified shop starting point; confirm with a controlled sew-out.
rows.label: Possible gap between fill and outline
possible_causes: Fabric pull-in may not be compensated
rows.remedy: Measure the gap on a flat sample and review pull compensation.
rows.capability_gap: Pull-compensation editing is unavailable. Photo pixels are not a measured millimetre adjustment.

rows.source_note: User advisory-intelligence brief, 2026-09-21. Unverified shop starting point; confirm with a controlled sew-out.
rows.label: Possible interrupted thread coverage
possible_causes: The photograph does not establish whether a thread actually broke
rows.remedy: Confirm the break with the machine operator, then measure the affected region against the rest of the plan.
rows.capability_gap: Photo-to-object registration and regional density comparison are not implemented. No tension diagnosis or numeric remedy is justified.

rows.source_note: User advisory-intelligence brief, 2026-09-21. Unverified shop starting point; confirm with a controlled sew-out.
rows.label: Possible stitches sinking into pile
rows.remedy: For confirmed towel or fleece, consult the topping recommendation before a test sew-out.
rows.capability_gap: Topping is a physical material, not an editable stitch operation.
